title: Forwarded email: price correction plus a lab-dip approval
subject: Fwd: LB-3308 price + lab dip
body:
Karthik, see below from Elin – please update the order. – Suresh

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Elin Lindqvist <elin@lindqvist-berg.example>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026
Subject: LB-3308 price + lab dip
To: Suresh <suresh@srivelanknits.example>

Hi Suresh,

The PDF we sent for LB-3308 had the wrong price: it should be EUR 3,75 per piece, as agreed. Please correct it on your side.

Also, the lab dip for Fjord Blue is approved (option B).

Best,
Elin
Lindqvist & Berg AB
